reproduction.design: success rate of each released checkpoint, n=3500; published values from the HEIGHT paper (n=500)

protocol.design: two-sided two-proportion z, alpha 0.05, rates 0.88 vs 0.90; best-of-five bias is E[max of 5 standard normals]

oracle_range.design: oracle minus occluded success, frozen seed-1 checkpoint, unpaired two-proportion z; Bonferroni threshold 0.05/5; 25 m discordance by episode index

architecture.design: three fine-tuning seeds vs the released checkpoint; one-sample t on the seed mean (df=2); exploratory TOST combining the seed SE (df=2) and the binomial SE of HEIGHT (Welch-Satterthwaite df)

shield.design: pedestrian-only shield (cbf.obstacles not set; default False), horizon 10 steps, margin 0.10 m; off/on paired by episode index within each checkpoint (shared reset seed/index design; initial-scene hashes not archived); HEIGHT and ours unpaired. Per-type tests are exploratory: family of four (two checkpoints x pedestrian/obstacle).

pairing_evidence.qualification: Shared checkpoint path and archived seed/index reset design; no archived scene or run-time checkpoint hashes.
Shared checkpoint path and archived seed/index reset design; no archived scene or run-time checkpoint hashes.

reciprocity.reactive_formula: 100 x visible_prob x E[dynamic/(dynamic+static)], dynamic ~ U{5..9}, static ~ U{0,1,2}
reciprocity.design: unpaired two-proportion z per level and for the 0.2->1.0 rise; Bonferroni threshold 0.05/5 for the five gaps

taxonomy.design: nearest pedestrian by surface gap at the final recorded step; z test of the non-reactive share against the population base rate 1 - 0.2 E[dyn/total]; Wilson 95% CI; approach direction from code/collision_taxonomy_v2.py (stationary <= 1e-8 m/s); speed trend = last recorded speed minus the speed five records earlier, tolerance 0.005 m/s

attribution_heading.design: second pedestrian within the margin of the nearest (surface gap); pessimistic share counts an ambiguous case as reactive if either candidate is; heading change = last change above the threshold in the pedestrian velocity heading (speed >= 0.05 m/s), within 1 s / 2 s of the last record

responsibility.design: agent-only negative-contribution share (code/responsibility.py, horizon 5 s) over pedestrian collisions with measurable conflict; control vs every eighth success by Welch t with exact t tail (responsibility.py itself prints a normal approximation)

ics.design: closed-prefix search [t0, t0+k] of code/ics_analysis_v2.py; historical cohort = collision records with >= 25 states and a non-reactive nearest pedestrian (385); no-escape = initial_contact + no_surviving_sequence

social.design: ours = seed 1 with ground-truth futures; intrusion = per-episode share of steps inside the 0.25 m discomfort zone; Welch t (exact tail) on per-episode arrays; HEIGHT vs its continuation also as a paired t over episode index (same seed sequence; scene identity not archived); navigation time = (steps - 1) x 0.1 s over successful episodes; seeds 2 and 3 have only the logged two-decimal means

deployable.design: each seed tested separately (unpaired) against HEIGHT-350M and the released checkpoint

path_jump.design: for consecutively numbered dumped episodes, logged path length = recorded path + jump to the next start
